product_updates.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
product_updates.content: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.

product_updates.title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn’t a virtue

technical_breakthroughs.title: The next generation of bionic hands is here—and they can feel
technical_breakthroughs.content: Avi Davidson lost his left hand as a teenager. Since then, he’s cycled through a few prosthetics. But his latest is different—it’s wired up to nerves in the upper part of his forearm and allows him to feel pressure. For the first time in years, he can use his left limb to handle delicate objects…
